hotels.title: Swan Valley Bushland Retreat Just 30 Minutes From Perth with Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Surrounded by rolling vineyards and the natural beauty of Western Australia’s Swan Valley, this refined retreat offers a tranquil escape just 35 minutes from Perth’s city centre. Tee off on the 18-hole golf course, or enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the resort’s squash courts or fitness centre. Savour quality barista coffee and loose-leaf teas, or share wood-fired pizzas and local beers at the casual Vines Cafe and Bar. Venture out to explore nearby artisan chocolate factories, boutique breweries and the acclaimed Swan Valley Food and Wine Trail.
